name: onemessagebus-visual-docs
//: `lint` is a syntax check over the scripts this project owns; there is deliberately no capture target, because screenshots are informational and no step that renders one is reachable from `just check`, `just gate` or ci.yml's gate job (screenshots/AGENTS.md). The guard's own behaviour is gated by crates/onemessagebus-repo/tests/visual_docs_guard.rs, which drives it with the three tools it shells out to stood in for. The `desk` layout bundle the capture links is `onemessagebus-e2e`'s, declared here rather than reached into. The one target is `bootstrap`, which activates the committed pre-push guard — the local half of the strict gate — so `just bootstrap` leaves a clean clone guarded.
